title: Function coverage for Return Bus Communication Error Count
purpose: Cover the diagnostics parser entry for the documented communication-error counter operation with a distinct, valid ADU.

messages.label: diagnostics request - return bus communication error count

expected_behavior: A compliant server that supports Diagnostics should process function 0x08 subfunction 0x000c and return the communication error count, or respond with an exception if unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length field 0x0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
PDU order preserved as function 0x08, subfunction, data
Data field retained as 2 bytes and set to 0x0000 conservatively
issue_safety_notes: PK-only valid request; distinct from other seeds by subfunction and unit identifier, with no malformed framing.
